tasks.final_text: This morning I thought I had a seminar at 11 am. I was going to be late, as always. So, a few minutes before the seminar was supposed to start (technically at 11:10), I was jogging from my dorm to the business school. I definetely looked very strange. When I finally made it to the room I found out that there was no longer any seminar. It had been cancelled. I went and got lunch...

The men's singles as a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
